top of page
Welcome to
OSERO SERENGETI
TENTED CAMP
A Magnificent Tented Camp in the Heart of the Serengeti Plains
​ ​
​ Nestled in the midst of the Serengeti National Park, our tented camp offers an unforgettable experience in the African wilderness. Surrounded by breath-taking landscapes and an abundance of wildlife, this prime location provides endless opportunities to explore Tanzania's natural beauty and connect with its rich culture. Whether you're here for adventure, relaxation, or wildlife encounters, your stay will be truly unforgettable.
BOOK NOW
OUR ACCOMMODATION
Osero - A Maasai Word Meaning "Bush"
Our spacious safari tents feature a king-sized bed, private ensuite bathroom, and an outdoor seating area that is perfect for relaxing and connecting with the soul of Africa. Experience authentic bush living in the Serengeti, without compromising on comfort.
DINING
Enjoy Our Uniquely Crafted Safari Cuisine
Our chefs create unforgettable gourmet meals inspired by local flavours, tailored to meet all special dietary needs. Dine in one of Africa's most breath-taking settings with cuisine as memorable as the wildlife.
Safari Tents & Accommodation
Relax in Our Authentic Wilderness Tents
Our spacious tented rooms offer a true safari experience, comfortable, private, and immersed in nature. Each tent includes mosquito nets and a private ensuite bathroom, designed to make you feel at home in the wild.
1/1
Accommodation & Pricing
Our camp offers two types of safari tent accommodation, both of which can be configured to suit your travel wants and needs. Perfect for couples, families, or solo adventurers.
More Information
Location
Our Camp is located near the central region of the Serengeti National Park, at Banagi 10.
Just a 15-minute drive from the heart of the Serengeti.
More information
Activities
We offer a wide range of safari activities including guided 4WD game drives , immersive Maasai cultural tours , and many more . All designed to enhance your Serengeti experience.
More information

ABOUT US
Karibu - Swalili for Welcome ​
​
Osero is a unique tented camp deep within the African wilderness of the Serengeti. As an open lodge, wildlife freely roams around and occasionally though the camp, creating an unmissable, immersive safari experience.
​
Our luxurious tents come equipped with all essential amenities for your comfort.
Surrounded by lush landscapes and enriched by the vibrant Maasai culture, your stay at Osero Serengeti promises an unforgettable expereince.
Karibu to Osero Serengeti Tented Camp​
Stay Within Nature
A Great Place to Make Memories That Will Last a Lifetime.
With 10 spectacular safari tents, Osero Serengeti Tented Camp invites guests to stay within reach of wildlife and experience the raw beauty and power of nature. Immerse yourself in the wild and witness the Serengeti at its most breath-taking.
​ ​
Don't just take our word for it, see what our guests say on Tripadvisor

top of page
ROOMS & RATES
Comfort and Style in the Heart of the Serengeti
Osero Serengeti Tented Camp offers 10 spacious tented guest rooms, along with a central lounge and dining area, all set against the beautiful backdrop of the Serengeti savannah and its roaming wildlife.
​
Each tent is thoughtfully equipped with: Mosquito nets, an ensuite private bathroom, handwashing basin, hot and cold safari showers, and a private outdoor seating area with a table and safari chairs.
​
Our tents can be arranged as single, double, twin, triple, or family rooms, ensuring flexibility for couples, friends, families, and solo travellers alike.
Connect with nature, feel the soul of Africa, and witness the wonders of the Serengeti right from your private outdoor seating area.
​
Whether you're enjoying a morning coffee or an evening glass of wine, every moment offers breath-taking views and the sounds of the wild.
Create meaningful moments and lasting memories in the heart of the African wilderness.
Our tented accommodation is available in two styles: Standard and Luxury, designed to suit a range of preferences of budgets.
​
Both options can be configured to your needs ensuring the perfect fit for you and your party.
Standard tents offer comfort and authenticity.
Our luxury tents provide additional space, upgraded furnishings, and extra touches of elegance for those seeking a more indulgent experience.
